title: Elon Musk sounds cautious note on robotaxis as rollout goes slow

title: Asia shares mixed, oil advances on US-Iran deadlock
title_zh: 亚洲股市涨跌互现，石油因美伊僵局而上涨
summary: By Rae Wee SINGAPORE, April 24 (Reuters) - Asia shares struggled on Friday and oil prices resumed their rise, as a shaky ceasefire in the Middle East war and stalled U.S.-Iran peace talks gave

title: Xiaomi has delivered 26,000 units of upgraded SU7 series sedan
title_zh: 小米升级版SU7系列轿车已交付2.6万辆
summary: Xiaomi, a well-known maker of ‌smart consumer electronics in China, ‌said on Friday that it had ​delivered 26,000 units of its upgraded SU7 series, which launched in March.
summary_zh: 中国知名智能消费电子产品制造商小米周五表示，其 3 月份推出的升级版 SU7 系列已交付 26,000 台。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures rise after Israel and Lebanon announce 3-week ceasefire extension

summary_zh: 以色列和黎巴嫩宣布将延长停火，主要指标几乎没有变化。

summary_zh: 故事：华尔街主要股指周四收低，其中道琼斯指数下跌逾三分之一，标准普尔 500 指数下跌约十分之四，而以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数下跌约十分之九。中东经济快速结束的希望越来越渺茫……

title: Why Microsoft is offering its first voluntary employee buyout
title_zh: 为什么微软要提供首次员工自愿买断
summary: Microsoft (MSFT) is planning its first-ever voluntary employee buyout for up to 7% of its US workforce. Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley discusses the news in the video above.
summary_zh: 微软 (MSFT) 正计划对其美国最多 7% 的员工进行有史以来的首次自愿员工买断。雅虎财经技术编辑 Dan Howley 在上面的视频中讨论了这一消息。

title: Meta plans to cut about 8K jobs amid ramped-up AI spending
title_zh: Meta 计划因人工智能支出增加而裁员约 8K
summary: Meta (META) confirmed it will be cutting 10% of its workforce — about 8,000 employees. Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley explains what we know so far.
summary_zh: Meta (META) 确认将裁员 10%，即约 8,000 名员工。雅虎财经技术编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 解释了我们目前所知的情况。
